rss: UK long-term borrowing costs hit highest since 1998 ahead of October Budget
title: Borrowing Costs Reach New Heights
story: In BizKid Land, the cost for borrowing money is going up. This is because the grown-ups are planning how to spend their money next month. Higher borrowing costs make it pricier to get loans.
storyBig: In BizKid Land, long-term borrowing costs have spiked, leading to increased pressure on government spending strategies. This mirrors the real-world economic environment where interest rate fluctuations impact fiscal decision-making.

rss: Ikea cuts prices as customers struggle with rising cost of living
title: Furniture Prices Drop as Costs Rise
story: In BizKid Land, the furniture store CHAIRS has decided to lower its prices. This is because families are finding it harder to buy new things with their money right now. Lower prices mean more fun furniture for less!
storyBig: Facing a challenging economic climate, CHAIRS, the leading furniture company in BizKid Land, has reduced prices due to consumer affordability concerns. This strategy aims to maintain market share amid rising living costs.
think: What would you do if you needed to sell more and people had less money?
bull: Lower prices mean more people can buy new furniture!
bear: Less money from sales could hurt the company's growth.
